screening.screening_rationale: Coherent photo description with concrete details, appropriate information density, logical organization, and natural speech. Minor disfluency ('the the') is common in spontaneous speech and not pathological.

Coherent description of complex visual scene with multiple elements. Minor disfluencies (filler word like, spatial descriptor repetition) are within normal range for spontaneous speech describing complex imagery under time constraints.

Contextually appropriate elaboration providing additional detail (luggage) in response to interviewer prompt for more information. Statement is concrete, informative, and maintains topic coherence with prior description of the same photo.

Coherent photo description with concrete scene elements and logical organization. Speech disfluencies present (article confusion a the, word repetition sitting sitting, awkward phrasing) are within normal spontaneous speech patterns and do not indicate formal thought disorder. Content remains informative and on-topic throughout.

Contextually appropriate single-word response to direct yes/no question asking for additional details. Brevity is fitting for question type and context (participant had already provided full photo description). Does not represent poverty of speech, which requires pattern of inappropriately brief responses when elaboration is expected.

Telegraphic but contextually appropriate list-style response to specific question about background elements. Provides three concrete, distinct background features (trees, river, forest). Brevity is fitting for listing items when asked specifically about background, not indicative of poverty of speech or content.
